lines: +"@solidjs/signals": patch

+A guessed node now stores two values, and its lane stores at most one more: `_value` is always what the screen shows, `_pendingValue` is what the hold will commit (the value the guess reverts to, staged when the guess is revealed, or a truth that landed beneath it), and the lane's record holds only a guess it has not revealed yet. The covered value kept beside a guess and beside lane derivations is gone, and so is the note of what the screen showed while a second guess on a shown guess waited (#4775): the screen's value is no longer written before the reveal. No rule or screen changes.
@@ -114,7 +114,8 @@ This is the model the signals engine is built to. The rules say what the screen

- **So a node carries at most three values:** what the screen shows; what its hold will commit, which is also what a guess reverts to (F-11); and one guess a lane has forked off and not yet revealed because its own async is still out. That guess shows when its async lands, even if the hold it was made over is still open (F-6). Until then the screen keeps what it showed, for every reader (F-1).

- **Anything else is outside the model:** a set-aside copy of a value, a note of what the screen is showing, a covered value kept beside the truth, a second pending slot, a per-node map or list that holds a value. A fix that needs one is not a fix. Stop and bring the case to the maintainer as a component in JSX with the screen after each step.

- **Do not add engine state so that a guess can come back or announce itself.** Optimistic state is for process, `isPending` is for data: the app shows work in flight with its own `createOptimistic(false)` flag set inside the action, or with `affects()` and `isPending` on the data. Fetching off an optimistic value is the author's choice, and the screen staying where it is until that work settles is correct.

-- **Three stores in the engine today are outside the model and are debt, not precedent:** the covered value in `covers` (`core/truth.ts`), and `kept` and `screens` (`core/guesses.ts`). Do not extend them, copy their shape, or add a fourth.

+- **In code:** `_value` is what the screen shows, `_pendingValue` is what the hold will commit, and `covers` (`core/truth.ts`) is a guess its lane has not revealed. `_x._revert` says a shown guess's pending value is still the value it reverts to, because nothing has answered it.
+- **One store in the engine today is outside the model and is debt, not precedent:** `kept` (`core/guesses.ts`), the set-aside guesses of #4336. Do not extend it, copy its shape, or add another.

## 7. Decision log
+- 2026-11-20: **A node stores two values; a lane stores a guess it has not
+  revealed** (the value model in the root `AGENTS.md`; F-11, F-6; no rule or
+  screen changes). Ruled the same day: one pending value per hold, a lane is
+  a hold of its own over its action, the lane's waiting guess is the one
+  value beside a node's two. Before, a guess's node kept more: the lane's
+  record (`covers`) held the guess until its reveal and then the value it
+  covered, also for lane derivations; a re-asked shown guess was written to
+  `_value` at once with a note of what the screen showed (`screens`, #4775).
+  Now `_value` is always the screen. `reveal` (lanes.ts) moves a waiting
+  guess from `covers` to `_value` and, with nothing staged beneath, stages
+  the value it showed over as `_pendingValue`: the revert is the hold's
+  write. `_x._revert` marks that staging, so `landed` (truth.ts) can tell a
+  truth that landed beneath the guess from the value it reverts to; the held
+  flag cannot (a same-tick truth lacks it, a refresh sets it). A re-asked
+  shown guess waits in `covers` (`setLaneValue`'s `wait`), still judged a
+  round later (`_reguessed`). A guess that becomes its lane's derivation
+  drops both (`laneStage`). `recompute`'s re-ask test ignores a staged
+  revert. `kept` (#4336) is unchanged. Census over the signals suite, nodes
+  at rest holding three values: 3,200 before, 21 after (16 a waiting guess,
+  3 `kept`).
